description: Suppression Level 60 Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander. Use the Glowing Crystal Prison on the Doomguard Commander. Be prepared for a ferocious onslaught of attacks, as the demon attempts to escape capture. Should you succeed, return the Imprisoned Doomguard to Daio in the Tainted Scar. Requirements: - Imprisoned Doomguard
name: Suppression
